description: Source code for the RTCoA WiFi device driver, including device discovery, configuration, resource management, and callbacks for thermostat devices.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiDeviceDriverInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the device driver, sets up callbacks, and supported device classes.

methods.name: startupDriver
methods.description: Starts monitoring existing devices and initializes discovery.

methods.name: shutdownDriver
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources for the device driver.

methods.name: discoverStop
methods.description: Stops discovery and cleans up pending thermostats.

methods.name: configureDevice
methods.description: Configures a thermostat device after discovery.

methods.name: writeResource
methods.description: Writes new values to device resources, such as mode and setpoints.

methods.name: thermostatDiscoveredCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a thermostat is discovered.

methods.name: thermostatStateChangedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when thermostat state changes.

methods.name: thermostatIpChangedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when thermostat IP address changes.
